svg.aria-label: The app's seven areas. Messaging: MLS group chats with NIP-59 invites, replies, edits, polls and math, folders that file chats, Ctrl+K search over local history, an offline send queue and on-device translation, plus Nostr cards and emoji from NIP-30, NIP-34, NIP-51 and NIP-84. Media: albums, video, voice, PDFs, archives, 3D models, and map and call cards, sent over MIP-04. Games: a .nes file gets a Play button, for mappers 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7, with no saves or gamepad. Accounts: several at once, with local nsec keys, NIP-46 remote signers through bunker links, and contacts as CSV or JSON. Look and feel: 35 themes and 5 accents from themes/*.toml, 5 languages at runtime, hover previews and full keyboard navigation. Mobile Linux: one view at a time with bottom navigation and Back, which keeps your draft, long-press actions and Linux ARM64 packages. Privacy and data: one vault and one password for every secret, Lock now without closing the window, OTLP metrics and audit logging off until you opt in, and backups that skip account keys.
